title: Mike and Fax
statementMd:
While Mike was walking in the subway, all the stuff in his back-bag dropped on the ground. There were several fax messages among them. He concatenated these strings in some order and now he has string $*s*$.

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bf91dd1798c0160282a69436cd3b80c3d77d7428.png)

He is not sure if this is his own back-bag or someone else's. He remembered that there were exactly $*k*$ messages in his own bag, each was a *palindrome* string and all those strings had the same length.

He asked you to help him and tell him if he has worn his own back-bag. Check if the given string $*s*$ is a concatenation of $*k*$ *palindromes* of the same length.

## Input

The first line of input contains string $*s*$ containing lowercase English letters ($1 ≤ |*s*| ≤ 1000$).

The second line contains integer $*k*$ ($1 ≤ *k* ≤ 1000$).

## Output

Print "YES"(without quotes) if he has worn his own back-bag or "NO"(without quotes) otherwise.

## Note

*Palindrome* is a string reading the same forward and backward.

In the second sample, the faxes in his back-bag can be "saddas" and "tavvat".
statementZhMd:
Mike 在地铁里行走时，背包里的所有物品都掉到了地上。其中有几条传真消息。他将这些字符串以某种顺序拼接起来，现在得到了字符串 $*s*$。

![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/bf91dd1798c0160282a69436cd3b80c3d77d7428.png)

他不确定这是不是自己的背包，还是别人的背包。他记得自己的背包里恰好有 $*k*$ 条消息，每条消息都是一个*回文串*，并且所有这些字符串的长度都相同。

他请你帮助他判断自己是否拿了自己的背包。请判断给定字符串 $*s*$ 是否可以表示为 $*k*$ 个长度相同的*回文串*的拼接。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个由小写英文字母组成的字符串 $*s*$（$1 ≤ |*s*| ≤ 1000$）。

第二行包含一个整数 $*k*$（$1 ≤ *k* ≤ 1000$）。

## 输出格式

如果他拿的是自己的背包，输出 "YES"（不含引号）；否则输出 "NO"（不含引号）。

## 说明

*回文串*是指正着读和反着读都相同的字符串。

在第二个样例中，他背包里的传真可以是 "saddas" 和 "tavvat"。
